text: Program Description The university reviews the completeness and authenticity of applicants’ materials, and organizes eligible applicants to participate in the entrance examination (divided into interview and written examination). 1. Interview: It focused on assessing the applicant’s comprehensive quality and language communication ability. 2.Written examination: Exam Subjects: English, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Mathematics. The university will conduct a comprehensive evaluation based on interview and written exam scores, and select the best candidates for admission. ★ Applicants can check the admission results on the international student service platform of Fujian Medical University, and the university will then send Admission Notice with the official seal of the university and the Visa Application Form for Foreign Students in China (JW202). ★After receiving the Admission Notice and Application Form for International Students to Study in China (JW202), applicants must bring the above materials, the original and photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Record , as well as their valid ordinary passport, to foreign visa agencies like the Chinese Embassy (Consulate General) to apply for a study visa (X1 visa) in China.
